subject: Under-stairs storage designed to fit
hook: Under-stairs storage made to measure in Stoke-on-Trent
gbp:
Under-stairs storage made to measure in Stoke-on-Trent.

The space under the stairs is often the most wasted in the house: tall at one end, tight at the other, and usually home to the meter, the hoover and a pile of shoes. We design storage that follows your stair slope so the whole space works, not just the front half.

Typical layouts combine tall pull-out units for coats and the hoover with deep drawers for shoes and bags, plus a hinged door wherever a meter or consumer unit needs to stay easy to reach. Finishes include matt, super matt, wood-effect and painted looks, with soft-close hardware as standard.

What is included: a free, no-obligation design consultation, a survey and an itemised quote with transparent pricing. Everything is manufactured and quality-checked in our own Hanley workshop, then delivered and installed by our own team. Nothing is flat-pack.

It suits families who need hallway storage that copes with a busy household, and anyone getting the house ready for visitors this winter.

Book a design consultation to talk through your space.
